name: DocumentExamination
description: Represents the formal document examination result for one presentation event. Records the examination decision, each document's individual compliance status, and any discrepancy codes (referencing UCP 600 and ISBP 745 articles). Immutable once finalised — examination results are auditable regulatory evidence. Owned by SVC-006.

fields.name: presentation_id
fields.description: Reference to the document presentation being examined.

fields.name: lc_id
fields.description: Reference to the LetterOfCredit for direct join convenience.

fields.name: examiner_id
fields.description: SVC-006 staff member who performed the examination (PER-059). Must hold CDCS or equivalent qualification per bank policy.

fields.name: examination_deadline
fields.description: UCP 600 Article 14(b) deadline: presentation_date + 5 banking days. Hard system constraint — not extendable.

fields.name: examination_result
fields.description: Overall examination outcome. deadline_missed triggers compliance incident (SVC-006 loses right to refuse under UCP 600 Article 16(f)).

fields.name: document_findings
fields.type: array of object { document_type: string, compliant: boolean, discrepancies: array of { discrepancy_code: string, ucp_article: string, isbp_paragraph: string, description: string } }
fields.description: Per-document examination results. Each discrepancy cites the specific UCP 600 article and ISBP 745 paragraph for legal precision.

fields.name: applicant_waiver_obtained
fields.description: True if applicant has formally waived discrepancies. Populated only where examination_result = discrepant.

fields.name: waiver_received_at
fields.description: Timestamp of applicant waiver instruction — must be before examination_deadline.

fields.name: waiver_instruction_reference
fields.description: Reference to applicant waiver instruction document (stored in SVC-054).

fields.name: swift_mt750_reference
fields.description: SWIFT MT750 (Advice of Discrepancy) reference if discrepancy notice transmitted to presenting bank.

fields.name: swift_mt734_reference
fields.description: SWIFT MT734 (Advice of Refusal) reference if refusal notice transmitted to presenting bank.

relationships.description: Examination belongs to one document presentation.
Examination references the parent LC directly.

design_decisions: DocumentExamination is immutable once examination_result is set. Any post-examination waiver creates a separate waiver record referenced by waiver_instruction_reference — the examination finding itself is never modified.

deadline_missed is a distinct terminal state from discrepant — it records the specific compliance failure (UCP 600 Article 16(f) preclusion) and triggers a separate compliance incident workflow, not the normal discrepancy management workflow.

Each discrepancy entry in document_findings cites both the UCP 600 article and the ISBP 745 paragraph. This is required for the SWIFT MT750/MT734 notice and for any subsequent dispute resolution under the ICC Banking Commission.
